_provenance.notes: Alaska sockeye salmon ex-vessel price cycles reflect global farmed Atlantic salmon competition, Japanese yen/USD exchange rates, and Bristol Bay run quality variability. The 1988 peak ($2.25/lb nominal) has never been matched in real dollars. The 2002 nadir ($0.42/lb) coincided with Chilean farmed salmon import flooding. The post-COVID recovery and Russia-Ukraine war (suppressing competing Russian salmon supplies) drove 2022-2024 prices to multi-decade highs.

price_drivers.yen_usd_sensitivity: Every 10-yen move in USD/JPY correlates with approx. $0.04-0.08/lb sockeye price shift
